newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Huge marijuana shipment seized in Vietnam's Saigon.
newsitem.headline: Huge marijuana shipment seized in Vietnam's Saigon.

text.p: Ho Chi Minh City's customs office said on Saturday that 6.3 tonnes of marijuana were seized at Vietnam's Saigon Port last week.

A customs official said the marijuana, which had been shipped from Cambodia via Singapore, came to light when a local transport and distribution firm under which it had been registered refused to take delivery of a container.
The official declined to give a street value for the haul, one of the customs office's biggest ever.
